digest.component_or_area: fsck and compact-all commands, ticket archival
propositions: rebar archive performs a terminal fold inline before writing the ARCHIVED event, ensuring all ticket events are folded at archive time rather than deferring to later compact-all runs

fsck and compact-all default to visiting only active (non-archived) tickets via a shared _ticket_dirs iterator that checks the .archived marker and confirms net-archived state, reducing O(all tickets) scans to O(active tickets)
Both fsck and compact-all accept an --include-archived flag to restore full store walks for deep audits and legacy ticket folding
A ticket with a stale .archived marker but no net-archived event state is still visited by default, preventing false negatives when archive state is reverted
Store-wide metrics (authorship tally, signed/unsigned event counts) always walk all ticket directories; the --include-archived flag scopes only which findings are reported
